profile.headline: Software Engineer - Residual Value Setting Tool at Ford Motor Company
profile.summary: Software Engineer participating in Ford's College Graduate Program, currently on the second year of rotations to experience what Ford has to offer.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Residual Value Setting Tool FCG
positions.description:
Software Engineer with the RVST team to determine vehicle residual values for NA vehicles for a potential cost savings of $40 mills over 5 years.
Utilizing Java with APIs , PCF, and Angular, with a likely transtion to GCP in the future.
Implementing CI/CD pipeline for Checkmarx, FOSSA, Gradle, Jenkins, Maven, and SonarQube.
Implementing custom intelligent monitoring using Dynatrace, Jenkins, SPLUNK, and SRE.

positions.title: Site Management - Tech & Software Platform Specialist
positions.description:
• Provided computer services to insurance adjusters, dealership auditors, remote sales teams, business Centers 
• Supported Ford Credit NA executives e.g. PC, iPhones, iPads, Satellite MYFI. 
• Helped coordinate PC Renewal and Managed Print Services for all NA Ford Credit locations. 
• Helped the coordination and removal of unused fax machines and printers and transitioned to e-mail faxes to reduce yearly costs of over $20k.
• Coordinated the transfer of multiple business centers network drives to a new cloud location for increased access and reduction of unused data.
• Ensured Business Center procedures to order computer supplies for field personnel kept up to date.

positions.title: Computer Consultant II
positions.description:
Troubleshooting problems for students and faculty on computers and classroom setups, and responding in a timely manner.
Maintained compliance with university, state and federal regulations, including proper handling of PII and HIPPA protected data.
Worked during during the Covid-19 Pandemic to assist students, staff, and faculty transition to distance learning and remote work.
Imaging and deploying desktops and laptops for faculty and transferring data from older machines.
Closed over 650 tickets after resolution and 95%+ positive feedback from surveys.

positions.title: CIS Grader
positions.description:
CIS 200: Computer Science II with Professor Thomas Steiner
CIS 310: Computer Organization & Assembly Language with Professor David Yoon
Grading over 200 students over the use of C++ and MASM coding assignments and exams.

positions.title: IT Intern
positions.description:
Interned on the Ford Foundational Services Identity team, providing updates to the login token API for various Ford logins.
Programming and services used: 
Object Oriented development
Java and Kotlin
Spring Boot on PCF and MS Azure
eXtreme Programming (XP) disciplines including paired programming and Test First / Test Driven Development
Spring Cloud and deploying to cloud platforms, Pivotal Cloud Foundry or Cloud Foundry
Working with other technical specialists, Product Managers, UI/UX Designers and product owners
Deliver API's supporting 100+ client mobile apps, web apps and internal apps. 
Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery tools and pipelines such as Jenkins, Maven, Gradle, etc.
positions.insights: Skills: Spring Boot · Test Driven Development · Java · Postman API · Kotlin

positions.title: Cashier
positions.description:
Processing customer payments accurately and efficiently.
Managing store finances and funds.
Upkeeping the professional appearance of the studio and offices.

positions.title: IT Intern
positions.description:
Imaging over 200 desktops and laptops to Windows 10 and transferring data from older machines for employees.
Deploying new machines to new employees and setting up accounts for the user.
Communicating with employees to set up appointments to update hardware and software.
Developing documentation on the process of updating the operating systems and software and company Agile standards.
Troubleshooting problems on computers and responding in a timely manner.
Keeping an inventory of computers and updating their location within a directory.

positions.title: Deli Slicer
positions.description:
Communicating effectively with guests and handling questions and concerns in a professional manner. 
Maintaining an organized, stocked, and sanitary workspace. 
Completing other restaurant functions such as cashier, cleaning, and other duties directed by the manager. 
Upholding a safe work environment while adhering to all established food and safety guidelines. 
Training new team members to perform assigned duties.

positions.title: Camp Counselor
positions.description:
Educating and mentoring campers in environmental science while leading groups of 10+ campers.
Ensuring the safety and security of campers.
Setting up and retrieving materials needed for daily group activities.
Communicating daily with other members on the team.
Providing assistance and consultation for campers as needed and when requested.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Computer Information Systems: Programming Associates Degree

volunteerExperiences.description:
I helped update/register 75+ citizens to vote, and verify current voter registration information for 300+ citizens.
Events: Mopop Music Festival 2022 and Panic at the Disco Detroit 9/20/22.
Helping care for the wellbeing of animals in the shelter's care by cleaning various items and spaces.

projects.title: Hotel Reservation Management System
projects.description: Project Lead, organized the team, delegated tasks, communicated with the customer. Created software engineering documentation and built a hotel reservation management system using C# and SQL. Software engineering documentation included use case definitions, artifact analysis, and design documents. The software included user login, reservation creation with availability tracking, hotel data setting changes, and file reading.
